decision: archive alternate POWER source not used by core reference build
checks: The file is a distinct alternate copy of BIOS power source; the selected BIOS build explicitly assembles bios/power.asm.
No core build link list or build script references the power21 directory.
A fresh BIOS build after archival has identical output and all 16 object hashes compared with the previous build.
limitations: This proves absence from the selected build, not equivalence of the two power variants or optional builds.
